landmarks.madeleine-factory: The courtyard and household wing of the lower-town factory, below the two long workshop roofs.
landmarks.montreuil-townhall: The roof of the civic building on the upper edge of the square.
landmarks.montreuil-square: Open paving between town-hall, station and cafe.
landmarks.montreuil-police-station: The small building at the right end of the square; exact historical address is not asserted.
landmarks.montreuil-officers-cafe-front: The square-facing frontage of the cafe, rather than the interior.
landmarks.montreuil-unpaved-alley: The earth-surfaced way among the lower-town houses; the source does not name it.
landmarks.montreuil-barber-shop: The modest shop block beside the lower side of the upper-town square approach; schematic site.
landmarks.montreuil-parsonage-door: The parsonage property beside the quiet approach toward the hire establishment; door site is schematic.
landmarks.scaufflaire-hire-yard: The stable and hire-yard property at the edge of the upper town.
landmarks.montreuil-post-office: The postal-establishment block southeast of the square; schematic site.
landmarks.montreuil-city-prison: The labeled prison property northwest of the square; precise address unknown.
landmarks.montreuil-cemetery: Inside the burial enclosure beyond the lower-right town edge.
landmarks.montreuil-countryside: Open agricultural ground below the western slopes; general countryside setting.
landmarks.montreuil-hesdin-road: The outward road at the upper-right margin; label direction is schematic.
landmarks.montreuil-paris-road: The outward road below the lower town gate, beside the cemetery approach.
landmarks.javert-montreuil-lodging: The labeled ordinary dwelling south of the square; no source address is inferred.
landmarks.montreuil-lodging-quarter: The poorer lower-town rental dwellings, represented at neighborhood scale without assigning either room an exact address.

landmarks.madeleine-women-workroom: The separate left workshop, without asserting access into the men’s room.
landmarks.madeleine-factory-lodge: Inside the portress’s small lodge beside the courtyard.
landmarks.madeleine-study: Clear floor below and beside the desk in the detached study detail.
landmarks.madeleine-bedroom: Clear floor within the upper private-room detail; no actual floor number is asserted.
landmarks.madeleine-bedroom-door: The threshold on the left edge of the chamber detail.
landmarks.madeleine-cashier-room: The room shown separately below the chamber, reflecting the stated vertical relation only.
landmarks.montreuil-factory-infirmary: The ward detail beside the bed, distinct from the town hospital.
landmarks.montreuil-infirmary-antechamber: The small room outside the ward and above its approach steps.
landmarks.montreuil-infirmary-laboratory: The standalone preparation-room detail; no corridor or precise ward adjacency is inferred.

landmarks.fantine-montreuil-room: Open floor in the earlier second-floor room, shown separately from the attic.
landmarks.fantine-montreuil-attic: Open floor in the cramped later roof lodging; the blank gap prevents a false claim of adjacency or shared address.
